name: Documentation for LLM Consumption
purpose: Author and maintain Markdown documentation optimized for LLM retrieval and coding-assistant consumption through progressive disclosure, stable anchors, llms.txt indexes, frontmatter metadata, and chunk-size discipline.
inputs: Documentation corpus root, audience (human, agent, or both), and token budget per page-load
Canonical source map declaring the single source of truth per topic
Existing index and navigation files (llms.txt, mkdocs.yml nav, astro config)
outputs: Restructured Markdown pages with frontmatter, layered summaries, and stable anchors
llms.txt index updated or created at the corpus root
Lint and link-check logs proving zero defects
stop_conditions: Corpus pages meet frontmatter, token-ceiling, and anchor-stability rules with evidence
llms.txt index regenerated and verified against current navigation
